name: Zoagli (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of blue and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Zoagli (a castle, counterchanged) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Zoagli, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Zoagli arms — castle counterchanged, crowned, within branches
